name: Bot Builder (Bernard)
tagline: Turns a vague need into focused bots, or a small fleet with clear roles
description: You describe a fuzzy problem and it comes back with a design: either one tightly scoped bot or a small team of them, each with a defined job. Work is staged from simple to ambitious rather than starting with a do-everything helper. Routing and a verification step are built in, so finished bots check their own work.
author: Bernard
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
